# Contributing to RLadies+ organisational guidance

The full contribution guidance lives in the guide itself:

- [Contributing to the guide](https://guide.rladies.org/guide/contributing/)
- [Content structure](https://guide.rladies.org/guide/content-structure/) — where a new page belongs

If you do not want to wrangle Git, [open an issue](https://github.com/rladies/rladiesguide/issues/new)
and tell us what is missing or wrong. That is a real contribution.

Please add your name to `.zenodo.json` so you are credited on the acknowledgements page and in the
next Zenodo release.
